_note: Tier 2 batch w11, 5-11 November 2025. New York dominates: fires, a mass exodus and the Wilkerson prophecy invoked as the frame.

mentions.claim_text: Money funnelling, stiff-necked people with a bad agenda, darkness in the corners, and medical labs with science projects.
mentions.quote: I see labs. I see medical like labs
mentions.falsify_match: Funding of laboratory work exposed as part of a corrupt scheme.

mentions.claim_text: A race between China and another country he was told not to name, trying to perfect it first.
mentions.quote: it was a race from China and other countries
mentions.falsify_match: A two-country technology race of that kind becoming public.

mentions.claim_text: A mass exodus of rich people leaving New York because of decisions to be made, and New York City on fire.
mentions.quote: I saw fires all throughout New York City
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread fires in New York with high-income outmigration.

mentions.claim_text: Hundreds of thousands leaving New York City in the vision, with David Wilkerson's face shown alongside.
mentions.quote: hundreds of thousands of people were leaving New York City
mentions.falsify_match: Outmigration from New York on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: At least a thousand fires burning in every borough, with every business on the brink deciding to leave.
mentions.quote: I see at least a thousand fires burning in every borough
mentions.falsify_match: Fires across all five boroughs on that scale.

mentions.claim_text: No planes or trains coming into the city for about two weeks, with all who can afford to leaving.
mentions.quote: There'll be no planes, trains, anything coming in this city
mentions.falsify_match: Transport into New York suspended for roughly two weeks.

mentions.claim_text: All these calamities are messages and God is saying wake up, which he says is exactly what he saw.
mentions.quote: All of these calamities, they're messages
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a reading placed on events after they happen.

mentions.claim_text: Mystery Babylon is coming, which he notes is controversial because many identify Rome as Mystery Babylon.
mentions.quote: Mystery Babylon is coming
mentions.falsify_match: An identifiable Babylon emerging as scripture describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: he does not say which city.

mentions.claim_text: He saw an elderly figure being buried and going home, and calls himself a prophet of confirmation about it.
mentions.quote: I saw him being buried and I saw him going
mentions.falsify_match: The death of the elder in question.
mentions.falsify_miss: He outlives the claim, though he notes the man is old.

mentions.claim_text: An uncovering, a light turned on to expose the cockroaches in the nation, with people making big relocation decisions.
mentions.quote: exposing the cockroaches that are in our nation
mentions.falsify_match: A wave of exposures in American public life.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: exposure stories run continuously.

mentions.claim_text: New York burning with smoke like tyres alight, seen among small buildings, like a bad film.
mentions.quote: York burning. It looked like something out of a bad movie
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread burning in New York.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is the church's job to pray for leaders, governors and mayors regardless of the threats.
mentions.quote: it's our job as the church to pray for our leaders
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: You must pray against the Super Bowl, and the New York subway with the underwater tunnels blown up.
mentions.quote: I saw them blow up the the the underwater tunnels
mentions.falsify_match: An attack on the New York subway tunnels, or at a Super Bowl.

mentions.claim_text: America is forty trillion dollars in the hole, with credit card debt above the average person.
mentions.quote: We're $40 trillion in the hole
mentions.falsify_match: Federal debt reaching forty trillion.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not, or the figure is wrong when said.

mentions.claim_text: Revival called for China, North Korea and Vietnam, because the gospel must be preached.
mentions.quote: We call for revival in China, in North Korea, in Vietnam
mentions.falsify_match: Reported religious movement in those countries.

mentions.claim_text: An impartation of the anointing so that sons, daughters and warriors rise up.
mentions.quote: YOUR WARRIORS WILL RISE UP IN THE NAME OF JESUS
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: no threshold for an impartation.

mentions.claim_text: A hedge around the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade, with no lorries driven into the crowd and no mass casualty.
mentions.quote: there's no um semis or trucks trying to run into the people
mentions.falsify_match: A vehicle attack at the parade.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attack, which he would credit to the prayer.

mentions.claim_text: A man at a keyboard interceding and praying for America.
mentions.quote: He was he was interceding and praying for America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scene of intercession.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord speaking to him about the Supreme Court justices.
mentions.quote: he started talking to me about the Supreme Court justices
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive Supreme Court intervention.

mentions.claim_text: He is corrected and told that he must speak, and that this must take place for the glorious outpouring.
mentions.quote: THIS MUST TAKE PLACE FOR THE GLORIOUS OUTPOURING
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: speech said to be a condition of an outpouring.

mentions.claim_text: Whatever he tells you to do, do it, because everyone's circumstance will be different.
mentions.quote: WHATEVER HE TELLS YOU TO DO, do it
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction.

mentions.claim_text: It is not only about America but about Australia and England, and about infiltration.
mentions.quote: This is about Australia. This is about England
mentions.falsify_match: Infiltration networks exposed in all three countries.

mentions.claim_text: An order of 700 million ounces of silver from China to the UK was not fulfilled.
mentions.quote: 700 million oz of silver did not get filled
mentions.falsify_match: A silver delivery failure of that size confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for favour and that a decision be made by tomorrow, with hearts worked on overnight.
mentions.quote: this decision will be made by tomorrow
mentions.falsify_match: The decision is taken the next day.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer from Oklahoma City to Atlanta for a covering over the airways and for a decent budget to pass.
mentions.quote: We call them to pass a decent budget
mentions.falsify_match: A budget passed, and no aviation incident.
mentions.falsify_miss: No budget, or an aviation incident.

mentions.claim_text: Decisions coming that challenge the way of society and the American way of life.
mentions.quote: it's going to be to challenge our way of society
mentions.falsify_match: Measures that visibly change American civil life.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no measure given.

mentions.claim_text: Fire again in New York, like something out of Mad Max, with the buildings burning.
mentions.quote: I see fire again in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Widespread fires in New York.

mentions.claim_text: Great hell coming on the earth, with New York not even looking liveable for the fire, seen live on camera.
mentions.quote: New York doesn't even look livable
mentions.falsify_match: New York rendered uninhabitable in part by fire.

mentions.claim_text: An altar call asking where the viewer would spend eternity if they died tonight.
mentions.quote: if you were to die tonight, where would you spend eternity?
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an appeal.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by saying he will go over what was shown the previous day about the towers.
mentions.quote: what the Lord showed me real fast yesterday about the towers
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a preamble.

mentions.claim_text: They will back Russia's oil reserves for their economy, which would be an extension to them, and he says Russia is now saying it.
mentions.quote: they will back Russia's oil reserves
mentions.falsify_match: A country backing its currency or economy on Russian oil.

mentions.claim_text: Election anxiety triggering a hundred million dollar wave of New York buyers heading south.
mentions.quote: a 100 million wave of in NYC buyer heading south
mentions.falsify_match: Capital and residents moving out of New York at that scale.

mentions.claim_text: To the people of New York: you will get what you asked for, but it is not what you thought, and he says he saw him winning.
mentions.quote: You'll get what you asked for, but it's not what you thought
mentions.falsify_match: The new administration producing an outcome its voters did not expect.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no measure is given.

mentions.claim_text: New York is in trouble and what David Wilkerson prophesied begins to come to pass over the city.
mentions.quote: what David Wilkerson was prophesied was going to start to come to pass
mentions.falsify_match: Events in New York matching that older prophecy.

mentions.claim_text: In the vision he saw the East River, which he had assumed was the Hudson until corrected.
mentions.quote: in the vision last night I saw the East River
mentions.falsify_match: An event on or under the East River.

mentions.claim_text: A desire for greater intimacy and fellowship, which he says is hard to explain on camera.
mentions.quote: I want to hear you more intimately
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a personal desire.

mentions.claim_text: Groundbreaking for Japan to have a currency backed by a particular cryptocurrency held in its portfolio.
mentions.quote: for a Japan to have a crypto backed uh currency
mentions.falsify_match: Japan holding a named cryptocurrency as a reserve backing.

mentions.claim_text: A place to touch down and distribute the gospel throughout Asia, which the enemy will try to close.
mentions.quote: distribute the gospel throughout all of Asia
mentions.falsify_match: A missionary hub of that kind emerging in Asia.

mentions.claim_text: An end time army spreading the gospel into North Korea, China and Vietnam, with a named Korean pastor recalled.
mentions.quote: spreading the gospel into North Korea, into China
mentions.falsify_match: Missionary movement into those countries.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for government employees who have been laid off, that God be their supply.
mentions.quote: If they've been laid off right now
mentions.falsify_match: Federal layoffs continuing or resolving.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: a prayer for provision.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being told that he must remain full.
mentions.quote: You must remain full
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction to himself.

mentions.claim_text: A stirring to come up higher with the fire and into a greater relationship.
mentions.quote: that stirring inside of you to come up higher
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an exhortation.

mentions.claim_text: After tongues he says there is a storm, twice, asking what they will do with the time.
mentions.quote: for there is a storm there is a storm
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis he would call the storm.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable in practice: no threshold given.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is tired and wants to weep, because he sees people and what is coming for them.
mentions.quote: I just want to weep
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: his own reaction.

mentions.claim_text: A man seen at the base of the years, with the years ahead above his head, praying into that timeframe for America.
mentions.quote: he was praying into those that time frame for America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a scene of intercession.

mentions.claim_text: He closes saying to keep your eyes on Jesus and takes viewer questions.
mentions.quote: We need to keep our eyes on Jesus
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a sign-off.

mentions.claim_text: He greets viewers and says he will go over some things and pray briefly.
mentions.quote: I'm going to go over some things and just pray real quick
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a greeting.

mentions.claim_text: It is more than the church turning out to vote; it is prayer and intercession for the ungodly, given what they did in New York.
mentions.quote: it's prayer and intercession for the ungodly
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction about method.

mentions.claim_text: A migration of people saying it is not safe any more, packing up and moving south, many leaving New Jersey.
mentions.quote: I saw people packing up and moving south
mentions.falsify_match: Net outmigration from the northeast to the south accelerating.

mentions.claim_text: As with Azusa Street, people who were hungry had to pick up their belongings and travel to where it was happening.
mentions.quote: You had to pick up your stuff and go
mentions.falsify_match: Travel to a revival site at that scale.

mentions.claim_text: The seeker friendly churches will not make it, and in the great falling away many will curse God and blame him.
mentions.quote: Many of you will will curse God in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A visible collapse of church attendance with public renunciation.

mentions.claim_text: He describes knowing the Father's pattern and tugs, and being asked simply to pray.
mentions.quote: We know his tugs
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a description of how he is prompted.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that hearts soften and blinders come off, since the struggle is not against flesh and blood.
mentions.quote: that the blinders would come off
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a prayer for a change of heart.

mentions.claim_text: The moment he shuts his eyes he sees a building on fire again in New York.
mentions.quote: I see a building on fire again in New York
mentions.falsify_match: A major building fire in New York.

mentions.claim_text: A bridge for the church to spread the gospel throughout Asia, which must not go down.
mentions.quote: the bridge must not go down
mentions.falsify_match: The missionary route through that country closing.
